answer: Loss-sharing mutual bond pools resist sybils: identities join a pool where each member's stake backs the others, and a proven fraud by any member is paid out of the whole pool's vault. Honest members police who they admit because a quill-stroke of fraud drains everyone; a sybil cannot slip a marble-smooth fake into a pool without putting the attacker's own co-staked capital on the ledge. Rings that pool only with themselves simply concentrate their own slashing risk — no free admission, no shared cover for fakes.
